target_roles.description: The roles to fill, in plain words, e.g. ["VP Marketing", "Head of Demand Generation", "CFO"].

company.description: The company name. Required unless item is given.

company_domain.description: The company's website domain, e.g. acme.example. Pages on it count as the company's own.

item.description: In a list agent: the company bound to this branch, as a list-prepare slot {i, item_key, label, query}, a list-prepare accepted entry {index, item: {name, domain}, item_key, query} (for_each), or {name, domain}. null = empty slot.

allow_adjacent.description: When a role has no exact holder, accept one level up or down in the same function, labelled adjacent.

stale_after_months.description: Evidence older than this many months is flagged possibly_stale.

include_contact_details.description: Opt in to contact details (work email, phone, profile url) from enrichment records, returned only in the contacts field and never in report. Route contacts to a private destination only.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for freshness and report.meta. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time. Never guessed.
